probability.reference_note: Observed cohort prevalence is a descriptive reference, not a fitted deployable baseline.
probability.macro_metric_note: Selection uses equal audited independent groups; patient_macro_brier retains original-ID descriptive aggregation.

denominator: Canonical false-warning rate uses adequately labeled forecast-eligible time, including quality-rejected windows. Unknown/current-AF/excluded time cannot dilute the operating budget. Total monitored time/coverage include all recording time, and false_warnings_per_all_recording_hour is a companion rate. Every eligible onset remains in event sensitivity, including events missed during abstention.

confidence_intervals.limitation: Small patient cohorts produce unstable intervals. All-correct events can yield a degenerate interval; bootstrap cannot bound unobserved misses or false warnings. Synthetic intervals are not clinical evidence.
